prompt: 私____学生です。
meaning: as for; marks the topic of the sentence
note: Noun + は · Written は but pronounced 'wa'. It sets up what the sentence is about; the key information comes after it. · I am a student.

prompt: 雨____降っています。
meaning: marks the subject; points out new or focused information
note: Noun + が · Question words such as だれ and 何 take が, never は, when they are the subject. が is also used with 好き, ほしい, 上手 and わかる for the thing liked, wanted or understood. · It is raining.

prompt: 毎朝パン____食べます。
meaning: marks the direct object of a verb; marks a place moved through or left
note: Noun + を · Written を but pronounced 'o'. With movement verbs such as 歩く, 散歩する and 出る it marks the route or the place being left. · I eat bread every morning.

prompt: 毎朝7時____起きます。
meaning: at; on; in (a specific point in time)
note: Noun + に · Used with clock times, dates, days of the week and months. Relative words such as 今日, 明日, 毎日 and 来週 take no に. · I get up at seven every morning.

prompt: 毎日バスで学校____行きます。
meaning: to; into (the destination of movement)
note: Noun + に + 行く / 来る / 帰る · Close in meaning to へ. に puts the focus on the arrival point, へ on the direction. · I go to school by bus every day.

prompt: 机の上____辞書があります。
meaning: in; at; on (where someone or something is)
note: Noun + に + ある / いる · Used with ある, いる and 住む. For the place where an action happens (eat, study, play), use で instead. · There is a dictionary on the desk.

prompt: 母____手紙を書きます。
meaning: to (the person who receives or is the target of an action)
note: Noun + に · Common with あげる, 貸す, 教える, 見せる, 電話をかける and 会う. With もらう and 借りる, に marks the person you get something from. · I'm going to write a letter to my mother.

prompt: 一週間____二回、プールで泳ぎます。
meaning: per; in (how many times within a period)
note: Noun + に + Noun · The period comes first, then に, then the number of times: 月に一回 (once a month). · I swim in the pool twice a week.

prompt: 夏休みに北海道____行きます。
meaning: to; toward (the direction of movement)
note: Noun + へ · Written へ but pronounced 'e'. Usually interchangeable with に for destinations; へ stresses the direction a little more. · I'm going to Hokkaido during summer vacation.

prompt: 図書館____本を読みます。
meaning: at; in (the place where an action happens)
note: Noun + で · Compare 教室にいます (being somewhere: に) with 教室で勉強します (doing something there: で). · I read books at the library.

prompt: 毎日電車____会社へ行きます。
meaning: by; with; in (means, tool, method or language)
note: Noun + で · To say 'on foot', use 歩いて行きます rather than で. · I go to work by train every day.

prompt: かばんの中にペン____ノートがあります。
meaning: and (joining nouns in a complete list)
note: Noun + と + Noun · と lists every item; to give just some examples, use や. It joins nouns only, not verbs or adjectives. · There is a pen and a notebook in my bag.

prompt: 週末、友達____映画を見ました。
meaning: with; together with (a partner in an action)
note: Noun + と · Often followed by いっしょに. With verbs like 話す, 会う and 結婚する, と marks the other person. · I saw a movie with a friend on the weekend.

prompt: 机の上に本____雑誌があります。
meaning: and (giving some examples out of more); ... and so on
note: Noun + や + Noun · Suggests the list is not complete. Often ends with など: 本や雑誌など. · On the desk there are books, magazines and so on.

prompt: 飲み物はコーヒー____紅茶がいいです。
meaning: or (a choice between nouns)
note: Noun + か + Noun · Means one of the items is chosen. To list items together, use と or や. · For a drink, coffee or tea would be good.

prompt: 私____学生です。
meaning: also; too; (with a negative) not ... either; neither ... nor
note: Noun + も · も replaces は, が and を, but comes after other particles: 京都にも行きました. · I'm a student too.

prompt: これは私____かさです。
meaning: 's; of (possession, belonging or description)
note: Noun + の + Noun · The first noun describes the second: 日本の車 (a Japanese car). The second noun can be dropped when clear: それは私のです. · This is my umbrella.

prompt: 授業は9時____です。
meaning: from (a starting point in time or place)
note: Noun + から · Often paired with まで: 月曜日から金曜日まで (from Monday to Friday). · Class starts at nine.

prompt: 昼休みは1時____です。
meaning: until; up to; as far as
note: Noun + まで · Marks the end point of something that continues. For a deadline ('by'), use までに (N4). · Lunch break is until one o'clock.

prompt: これはあなたの____ばんですか。
meaning: (question marker) turns a sentence into a question
note: Sentence + か · Polite questions end in か and are usually written with 。. In casual speech か is normally dropped and rising intonation is used instead. · Is this your bag?

prompt: 今日は暑いです____。
meaning: isn't it?; right? (seeking agreement or sharing a feeling)
note: Sentence + ね · Used when the speaker expects the listener to share the same view or knowledge. Compare よ, which tells the listener something new. · It's hot today, isn't it?

prompt: このラーメンはとてもおいしいです____。
meaning: you know; I tell you (giving new information or emphasis)
note: Sentence + よ · Tells the listener something they may not know. Overusing it with superiors can sound pushy. · This ramen is really good, you know.

prompt: 今日はきのう____寒いです。
meaning: than (the standard of comparison)
note: Noun + より · In X は Y より + adjective, Y is the standard. Japanese adjectives have no '-er' form; より does that job. · Today is colder than yesterday.

prompt: 犬の方が猫____好きです。
meaning: X is more ... than Y
note: Noun + の方が + Noun + より · The two parts can come in either order. Often used to answer a どちら question. · I like dogs more than cats.

prompt: コーヒーと紅茶____好きですか。
meaning: which is more ..., X or Y?
note: Noun + と + Noun + とどちらが · Compares exactly two things. どっち is the casual form of どちら. Answer with 〜の方が. · Which do you like better, coffee or tea?

prompt: 果物の中でりんご____好きです。
meaning: ... is the most ... among/of
note: Noun + の中で + Noun + が一番 · Used for three or more items. In questions use 何, だれ, どこ or いつ before が一番. · Of all fruits, I like apples the most.

prompt: 私はマリア____。
meaning: is; am; are (polite copula)
note: Noun + です / na-Adj + です / i-Adj + です · Forms: です, ではありません, でした, ではありませんでした. After an い-adjective, です only adds politeness: 高いです. · I'm Maria.

prompt: 今日は日曜日____。
meaning: is; am; are (plain copula)
note: Noun + だ / na-Adj + だ · Forms: だ, じゃない, だった, じゃなかった. Never used right after an い-adjective (高いだ is wrong). Often dropped in casual questions: 学生？ · Today is Sunday.

prompt: 私は先生____。学生です。
meaning: is not; am not; are not
note: Noun + ではありません / na-Adj + ではありません / Noun + じゃない / na-Adj + じゃない · じゃありません and じゃないです are more conversational polite forms. Past: ではありませんでした / じゃなかった. い-adjectives use 〜くない instead. · I'm not a teacher. I'm a student.

prompt: きのうは私の誕生日____。
meaning: was; were (polite past copula)
note: Noun + でした / na-Adj + でした · Past negative: ではありませんでした. い-adjectives do not take でした: say 高かったです, not 高いでした. · Yesterday was my birthday.

prompt: 毎朝コーヒーを飲み____。
meaning: polite non-past verb ending (do; will do)
note: Verb-stem + ます · Covers habits and future actions. 飲む→飲みます, 食べる→食べます, する→します, 来る→来ます. · I drink coffee every morning.

prompt: 私はお酒を飲み____。
meaning: do not; will not (polite negative)
note: Verb-stem + ません · The plain equivalent is the ない-form: 飲みません = 飲まない. · I don't drink alcohol.

prompt: きのう、友達に会い____。
meaning: did (polite past)
note: Verb-stem + ました · The plain equivalent is the た-form: 会いました = 会った. · I met a friend yesterday.

prompt: けさは朝ご飯を食べ____。
meaning: did not (polite past negative)
note: Verb-stem + ませんでした · The plain equivalent is 〜なかった: 食べませんでした = 食べなかった. · I didn't eat breakfast this morning.

prompt: 今日は学校へ行か____。
meaning: do not; will not (plain negative of verbs)
note: Verb-nai stem + ない · う-verbs change the last -u sound to -a: 書く→書かない, 買う→買わない. る-verbs drop る: 食べない. する→しない, 来る→こない, ある→ない. Past: 〜なかった. · I'm not going to school today.

prompt: 週末は家で映画を見____。
meaning: did (plain past of verbs)
note: Verb-ta · Made exactly like the て-form, with て→た and で→だ: 書いて→書いた, 飲んで→飲んだ, 行って→行った. Polite equivalent: 〜ました. · I watched a movie at home over the weekend.

prompt: いっしょに行き____。
meaning: let's (do)
note: Verb-stem + ましょう · Used when the speaker expects the listener to agree. To invite more gently, use 〜ませんか. · Let's go together.

prompt: 窓を開け____。
meaning: shall I ...?; shall we ...?
note: Verb-stem + ましょうか · Offers to do something for the listener (shall I?) or asks them to decide something together (shall we?). · Shall I open the window?

prompt: いっしょに昼ご飯を食べ____。
meaning: won't you ...?; would you like to ...? (polite invitation)
note: Verb-stem + ませんか · Gentler than 〜ましょう because it leaves the listener room to decline. Accept with ええ、〜ましょう. · Would you like to have lunch together?

prompt: 夏休みに沖縄へ行き____です。
meaning: want to (do)
note: Verb-stem + たい · Conjugates like an い-adjective: 〜たくない, 〜たかった. The object can take が or を. Not used to state another person's wishes directly. · I want to go to Okinawa during summer vacation.

prompt: 新しいパソコン____です。
meaning: want (something)
note: Noun + がほしい · For things, not actions (actions use 〜たい). Conjugates like an い-adjective: ほしくない, ほしかった. · I want a new computer.

prompt: すみません、水____。
meaning: please give me (something); I'll have
note: Noun + をください · Used when shopping or ordering. A quantity goes after を with no particle: 切手を二枚ください. · Excuse me, could I have some water?

prompt: もう少しゆっくり話し____。
meaning: please (do)
note: Verb-te + ください · Polite, but still an instruction the speaker expects to be followed. Softer requests use 〜てくれませんか (N4). · Please speak a little more slowly.

prompt: 教室で食べ____。
meaning: please don't (do)
note: Verb-nai + でください · Softer than 〜てはいけません. In casual speech ください is dropped: 見ないで. · Please don't eat in the classroom.

prompt: この辞書を使っ____ですか。
meaning: may; it's okay to
note: Verb-te + もいい · Add ですか to ask for permission. A polite refusal is often just すみません、ちょっと…. · May I use this dictionary?

prompt: 図書館で大き____声で話してはいけません。
meaning: must not; may not
note: Verb-te + はいけない · A strong prohibition, often for rules. Polite form: 〜てはいけません. Casual contraction: 〜ちゃいけない / 〜じゃいけない. · You must not talk loudly in the library.

pattern: 〜なければならない / 〜なくてはいけない
prompt:
明日は6時に起きなければなりません。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: must; have to
note: Verb-nai stem + なければならない / Verb-nai stem + なくてはいけない · Polite forms end in なりません / いけません. The two mean the same; なければならない sounds slightly more formal. · I have to get up at six tomorrow.

prompt: 明日は学校へ来____です。
meaning: don't have to; need not
note: Verb-nai stem + なくてもいい · The opposite of 〜なければならない. Ask with 〜なくてもいいですか (Is it all right if I don't ...?). · You don't have to come to school tomorrow.

prompt:
弟は今、部屋でゲームをしています。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: be doing (ongoing action); be in a state (result of a change); do regularly
note: Verb-te + いる · With action verbs (食べる, 読む) it shows an action in progress; with change verbs (結婚する, 開く, 知る) it shows the resulting state. Polite: 〜ています. · My younger brother is playing a game in his room now.

prompt: 朝起き____、顔を洗います。
meaning: and; and then (linking actions in order)
note: Verb-te + Sentence · The final verb sets the tense for the whole sentence. 書く→書いて, 飲む→飲んで, 話す→話して, 買う→買って, 行く→行って (irregular). · I get up in the morning and wash my face.

prompt: 手を洗っ____、ご飯を食べましょう。
meaning: after doing; (do A) and then (B); since
note: Verb-te + から · Stresses that A is finished before B starts, more clearly than a plain て. With ている in the main clause it often means 'since'. · Let's wash our hands and then eat.

prompt:
日曜日はそうじをしたり、洗濯をしたりします。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: do things like A and B; sometimes A, sometimes B
note: Verb-ta + り + Verb-ta + りする · Picks out a few actions from many. Tense and politeness go on the final する: 〜たりしました. · On Sundays I do things like cleaning and laundry.

prompt:
富士山に登ったことがあります。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: have (ever) done; have the experience of doing
note: Verb-ta + ことがある · Talks about life experience, not something just done: きのう食べたことがある is wrong. Negative 〜たことがありません means 'have never'. · I have climbed Mt. Fuji.

prompt: 寝る____歯をみがきます。
meaning: before (doing); before (an event); ago
note: Verb-dict + 前に / Noun + の + 前に · The verb before 前に is always in dictionary form, even when talking about the past. With a length of time there is no の: 3年前に (three years ago). · I brush my teeth before going to bed.

prompt: 晩ご飯を食べた____、散歩をします。
meaning: after (doing); after (an event)
note: Verb-ta + 後で / Noun + の + 後で · The verb before 後で is always in た-form, even for future plans. On its own, 後で means 'later'. · I take a walk after eating dinner.

prompt: 音楽を聞き____勉強します。
meaning: while (doing two actions at the same time)
note: Verb-stem + ながら · Both actions are done by the same person. The main action comes last: in A-ながら B, B is the main activity. · I study while listening to music.

prompt:
デパートへ服を買いに行きます。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: go (somewhere) to do
note: Verb-stem + に行く / Noun + に行く · 来る and 帰る work the same way: 遊びに来る. With する-nouns the noun can come directly: 買い物に行く, 散歩に行く. · I'm going to the department store to buy clothes.

prompt: 私は甘いもの____です。
meaning: like; dislike
note: Noun + が好き / Noun + が嫌い / Verb-dict + の + が好き · 好き and 嫌い are な-adjectives, so the thing liked takes が, not を. 大好き and 大嫌い are stronger. 嫌い can sound blunt; あまり好きじゃない is softer. · I like sweet things.

prompt: 姉はピアノ____です。
meaning: good at; bad at
note: Noun + が上手 / Noun + が下手 · Mostly used about other people; calling yourself 上手 can sound like bragging. Both are な-adjectives: 料理が上手な人. · My older sister is good at the piano.

prompt:
公園に大きい木があります。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: there is; there are; have (ある for things, いる for people and animals)
note: Noun + がある / Noun + がいる · ある is for things, plants and events; いる is for people and animals. Negatives: ない / いない (polite: ありません / いません). · There is a big tree in the park.

prompt: 今日は寒い____、コートを着ます。
meaning: because; since; so
note: Sentence + から · The reason comes first: A から B (A, so B). Answer どうして with 〜からです. Nouns and な-adjectives need だ: 雨だから. · It's cold today, so I'll wear a coat.

prompt: この店は安いです____、あまりおいしくないです。
meaning: but; although
note: Sentence + が · Also used just to soften a request or lead into a topic: すみませんが…. A little more formal than けど (N4). · This restaurant is cheap, but the food isn't very good.

prompt: 明日は雨が降る____。
meaning: probably; I think; ..., right?
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + でしょう · Typical of weather forecasts. Said with rising intonation, it asks the listener to agree. Plain form: だろう (N4). · It will probably rain tomorrow.

prompt:
あたたかくなりましたね。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: become; get; turn
note: i-Adj-ku + なる / na-Adj + になる / Noun + になる · いい becomes よくなる. Often used in the past to describe a change that has happened: 大きくなりました. · It's gotten warmer, hasn't it?

prompt:
私はカレーにします。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: decide on; choose; I'll have
note: Noun + にする · Common when ordering food or picking from options. Past: 〜にしました (I decided on ...). · I'll have the curry.

prompt: まだ昼ご飯を食べて____ません。
meaning: not yet (have done)
note: まだ + Verb-te + いない / まだ + Verb-te + いません · Use ていない, not ませんでした, for something that may still happen. The short answer is いいえ、まだです. · I haven't eaten lunch yet.

prompt: 「もう晩ご飯を食べまし____か。」「はい、もう食べました。」
meaning: already (have done); (in questions) yet
note: もう + Verb-ta / もう + Verb-stem + ました · In questions もう means 'yet'. With a negative verb, もう means 'no longer': もう食べません. · "Have you eaten dinner yet?" "Yes, I already have."

prompt:
私はあまりテレビを見ません。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: not very; not much; not often
note: あまり + Verb-nai / あまり + i-Adj-ku + ない / あまり + na-Adj + じゃない · Always followed by a negative form. あまり好きじゃない is a softer way to say you dislike something. · I don't watch much TV.

prompt:
この問題は全然わかりません。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: not at all; not in the least
note: 全然 + Verb-nai / 全然 + i-Adj-ku + ない / 全然 + na-Adj + じゃない · Stronger than あまり〜ない. In casual speech 全然 is sometimes used with positive words (全然大丈夫), but with a negative is the standard use. · I don't understand this question at all.

prompt: 財布に100円____あります。
meaning: only; just
note: Noun + だけ / Verb-dict + だけ · Neutral in tone. Compare しか〜ない (N4), which stresses that the amount is small. · I only have 100 yen in my wallet.

prompt: 駅まで歩いて10分ぐ____です。
meaning: about; approximately (an amount or length of time)
note: Noun + くらい / Noun + ぐらい · Used with amounts and durations. For a point in time (around three o'clock), use ごろ: 3時ごろ. · It's about a ten-minute walk to the station.

prompt: 毎晩11時____寝ます。
meaning: around; about (a point in time)
note: Noun + ごろ · Attaches to clock times, dates and months. に after ごろ is optional: 7時ごろ(に)起きます. · I go to bed around eleven every night.

pattern: 何も〜ない / 誰も〜ない
prompt:
けさは何も食べませんでした。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: nothing; nobody; not anything; not anyone
note: 何も + Verb-nai / 誰も + Verb-nai · With places, a particle comes before も: どこにも / どこへも行きません (go nowhere). 誰 is often written in hiragana: だれ. · I didn't eat anything this morning.

pattern: 何か / 誰か / どこか
prompt: 何____飲みますか。
meaning: something; someone; somewhere
note: Question word + か · Question word + か gives 'some-' words; question word + も + negative gives 'no-' words. が and を after 何か / だれか are often dropped. · Would you like something to drink?

pattern: これ / それ / あれ / どれ
prompt: ____は私の辞書です。
meaning: this one; that one (near you); that one (over there); which one
note: これ / それ / あれ / どれ · こ = near the speaker, そ = near the listener, あ = away from both, ど = question. They stand alone; as a subject どれ takes が, not は. · This is my dictionary.

pattern: この / その / あの / どの
prompt: ____ケーキはおいしいです。
meaning: this; that (near you); that ... over there; which (before a noun)
note: この / その / あの / どの + Noun · Always followed by a noun: この本, never この alone. これ / それ / あれ / どれ are used when there is no noun. · This cake is delicious.

pattern: ここ / そこ / あそこ / どこ
prompt: ____こは私の学校です。
meaning: here; there (near you); over there; where
note: ここ / そこ / あそこ / どこ · こちら / そちら / あちら / どちら are politer versions: お国はどちらですか (Where are you from?). · This is my school.

prompt:
この部屋はあまり広くないです。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: negative and past forms of i-adjectives (is not; was; was not)
note: i-Adj stem + くない / i-Adj stem + かった / i-Adj stem + くなかった · 高い→高くない, 高かった, 高くなかった. Add です to be polite. いい is irregular: よくない, よかった, よくなかった. · This room isn't very big.

prompt: 京都は有名____町です。
meaning: na-adjectives: take な before a noun and です or だ at the end of a sentence
note: na-Adj + な + Noun / na-Adj + です / na-Adj + ではありません / na-Adj + でした · Before a noun, add な: 静かな部屋. At the end of a sentence they change like nouns. きれい and きらい end in い but are な-adjectives. · Kyoto is a famous city.

prompt: この店は安____おいしいです。
meaning: and (linking adjectives or nouns)
note: i-Adj-ku + て / na-Adj + で / Noun + で · いい becomes よくて. Join qualities that point the same way (both good or both bad); for a contrast, use が instead. · This restaurant is cheap and good.

prompt: これは「すきやき」____料理です。
meaning: called; named
note: Noun + という + Noun · Introduces a name the listener may not know. · This is a dish called sukiyaki.

pattern: あげる / くれる / もらう
prompt:
私は弟に古いゲームをあげた。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: give (to someone else); give (to me or my group); receive
note: Noun (receiver) + に + Noun + を + あげる / Noun (giver) + が + Noun + を + くれる / Noun (giver) + に + Noun + を + もらう · くれる is used only when the receiver is the speaker or someone in the speaker's group. With もらう the giver can be marked with に or から. · I gave my old game to my little bro

prompt:
妹の宿題を手伝ってあげました。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: do something for someone (as a favor)
note: Verb-te + あげる · Said directly to a superior it can sound condescending; use the humble お〜しましょうか (お持ちしましょうか) instead. · I helped my little sister with her homework.

prompt:
友達が引っ越しを手伝ってくれた。

note: Verb-nai stem + せてください (Group 1) / Verb-nai stem + させてください (Group 2) · Built on the causative て-form (する → させて). 〜させていただけませんか is more polite. · Please let me think about it for a bit.

prompt:
社長は何時ごろいらっしゃいますか。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: honorific verbs; respectful language for others' actions
note: いらっしゃる（行く・来る・いる） / 召し上がる（食べる・飲む） / おっしゃる（言う） / なさる（する） / ご覧になる（見る） / くださる（くれる） · Raises the actions of people you respect, such as customers, teachers and superiors. Never use it for your own actions. · Around what time will the company president be here?

prompt:
明日の午後、そちらに伺います。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: humble verbs; modest language for one's own actions
note: 参る（行く・来る） / おる（いる） / いただく（食べる・飲む・もらう） / 申す（言う） / いたす（する） / 拝見する（見る） / 伺う（聞く・訪ねる） · Lowers your own actions, or your group's, toward someone you respect. 参る, おる, 申す and いたす also make speech sound formal in general. · I'll come to your office tomorrow afternoon.

prompt:
先生はもうお帰りになりました。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: (honorific) someone respected does
note: お + Verb-stem + になる · Not used with one-syllable stems (見る, 寝る) or verbs that have special forms (行く → いらっしゃる). する-nouns take ご + Noun + になる (ご利用になる). · The teacher has already gone home.

prompt:
重そうですね。お持ちしましょうか。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: (humble) I do (for someone respected)
note: お + Verb-stem + する / ご + Noun + する · Only for actions that affect or benefit the other person. お〜いたします is even more formal. · That looks heavy. Shall I carry it for you?

prompt: お手洗いはあちら____。
meaning: is; am; are (very polite copula)
note: Noun / na-Adj + でございます · The very polite version of です, typical of shop and hotel staff speaking to customers. ございます on its own is the polite form of あります. · The restroom is over there.

prompt: ここに荷物を置____ても構いませんか。
meaning: don't mind if; it's fine if
note: Verb-te + も構わない / i-Adj-ku + ても構わない / na-Adj + でも構わない / Noun + でも構わない · A little more formal than 〜てもいい. 〜なくても構わない means 'it's fine not to'. · Do you mind if I leave my bags here?

prompt:
私は写真を撮るのが好きです。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: the act of doing (turns a verb phrase into a noun)
note: Verb-plain + の / Verb-plain + こと · の is preferred with perception verbs (見る, 聞こえる) and in casual speech; こと is needed before です/だ and in set patterns such as 〜ことができる. · I like taking photos.

prompt: もっと早く家を出れ____。
meaning: should have (done); I wish I had
note: Verb-ba + よかった / Verb-nai stem + なければよかった · Expresses regret about the past. 〜たらよかった is a common conversational alternative. · I should have left home earlier.

prompt: 疲れているなら、少し休んだ____？
meaning: why don't you ...?; how about ...?
note: Verb-ta + らどう · Often shortened to 〜たら？. Can sound pushy toward superiors; 〜たらいかがですか is the polite version. · If you're tired, why not rest a bit?

prompt: 熱があるなら、病院に行った____ですよ。
meaning: had better; should
note: Verb-ta / Verb-nai + ほうがいい · For advice, the past form (行ったほうがいい) is the usual choice and sounds stronger. The negative uses the ない form, not the past. · If you have a fever, you'd better go to the hospital.

prompt: 冷蔵庫に卵____牛乳とかが入っています。
meaning: things like A and B; A, B and so on (casual)
note: Noun + とか + Noun + とか / Verb-dict + とか + Verb-dict + とか · More casual than 〜や〜など, and it can also list verbs or whole phrases. · There are things like eggs and milk in the fridge.

prompt: 机の上に本やノート____があります。
meaning: etc.; and so on; such as
note: Noun + など · Often paired with や (AやBなど). After a single noun it softens a suggestion. · On the desk there are books, notebooks and so on.

prompt: ちょっと休んで、コーヒー____飲みませんか。
meaning: or something (softening a suggestion)
note: Noun + でも · Offers one example while leaving other options open, which makes invitations and advice sound less pushy. · Why don't we take a break and have a coffee or something?

prompt: この橋の長____はどのくらいですか。
meaning: -ness (turns an adjective into a noun of degree)
note: i-Adj stem + さ / na-Adj + さ · いい becomes よさ. Common for measurements (高さ, 重さ, 大きさ, 長さ). · How long is this bridge?

prompt: 右から三つ____の建物が図書館です。
meaning: -th (ordinal: first, second, third ...)
note: Noun (number + counter) + 目 · The third building from the right is the library.

prompt: このバスは十五分____来ます。
meaning: every other; at intervals of
note: Noun (number + counter) + おきに · With days (一日おき) it skips one unit, meaning 'every other day'. With minutes or distances it usually just means 'every X'. · This bus comes every fifteen minutes.

prompt:
テレビの音を小さくしてください。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: make (something) ...; change something to a state
note: i-Adj-ku + する / na-Adj + に + する / Noun + に + する · Someone deliberately changes something. Compare 〜くなる / 〜になる, where the change happens by itself. · Please turn the TV down.

prompt: 台所からいいにおい____。
meaning: (a smell, sound, taste or feeling) is perceived
note: Noun + がする · Used with におい, 音, 声, 味 and 気 (〜気がする: 'have a feeling that'). · There's a nice smell coming from the kitchen.

prompt:
明日は晴れるかな。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: I wonder
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + かな / かしら · A soft question, often said to oneself. かしら sounds feminine and a little old-fashioned. 〜ないかな can express a wish (早く来ないかな). · I wonder if it'll be sunny tomorrow.

pattern: 〜てくれませんか / 〜ていただけませんか
prompt: すみません、写真を撮ってくれ____。
meaning: could you please ...? (polite request)
note: Verb-te + くれませんか / Verb-te + いただけませんか · Softer than 〜てください. Politeness rises from 〜てくれませんか to 〜てもらえませんか to 〜ていただけませんか. · Excuse me, could you take my picture?

prompt: 今朝は朝ご飯を食べ____学校に行った。
meaning: without doing; instead of doing
note: Verb-nai + で · 〜ずに (N3) means the same but is more formal. Differs from 〜なくて, which gives a reason. · This morning I went to school without eating breakfast.

prompt: 三年も中国に住んでいたんですか。____から中国語が上手なわけですね。
meaning: no wonder; that's why; it follows that
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + という + わけだ · States a conclusion that follows naturally from known facts, often with a feeling of 'now I understand'. Often preceded by だから, それで or どうりで. · You lived in China for three years? That's why your Chinese is so good.

prompt: 料理が嫌いな____が、毎日作る時間がない。
meaning: it doesn't mean that; it's not that; not necessarily
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + という + わけではない · A partial or soft denial of what the listener might assume. Often with いつも, 全部 or 必ずしも. Not the same as 〜わけがない, which flatly rules something out. · It's not that I dislike cooking, but I don't have time to cook every day.

prompt: こんなに練習したんだから、負ける____。
meaning: there's no way that; cannot possibly
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + わけがない · The speaker's strong conviction that something is impossible. Casual: 〜わけない. Close to 〜はずがない, but sounds more emotional and less based on reasoning. · We've practiced this hard, so there's no way we'll lose.

prompt: 明日は大事な会議があるから、休む____。
meaning: can't afford to; can't very well; must not (for social or moral reasons)
note: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + わけにはいかない · The action is physically possible but ruled out by duty, circumstances or common sense. 〜ないわけにはいかない means 'have to; can't avoid doing'. · There's an important meeting tomorrow, so I can't afford to take the day off.

prompt: 子どものころは、この川でよく泳いだ____。
meaning: it's natural that; one should; used to (nostalgia); how ...! (deep feeling)
note: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものだ · Main uses: general truth or natural tendency, a social norm (should), a nostalgic past habit with 〜たものだ, and deep feeling (時間がたつのは早いものだ). Casual: 〜もんだ. · When I was a child, I used to swim in this river a lot.

prompt: 人の失敗を笑う____。
meaning: one shouldn't; it's not right to
note: Verb-dict + ものではない · Advice based on common sense or social norms, often from an older person. Casual: 〜もんじゃない. Sounds more like general wisdom than 〜べきではない. · You shouldn't laugh at other people's mistakes.

prompt: 「どうして食べない____？」「だって、ピーマン嫌いなんだもん。」
meaning: because (casual excuse or self-justification)
note: Sentence + もの / もん · Sounds pouty or self-justifying; often begins with だって. もん is more colloquial. Used by children and among close friends; avoid at work. · 'Why aren't you eating?' 'Because I hate green peppers!'

prompt: 道がすごく混んでいた____、約束の時間に間に合わなかった。
meaning: because; since (explaining or excusing a situation)
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + な + ものだから / もので · Explains or excuses something that wasn't fully under the speaker's control. The main clause can't be a command or request. もので is common in polite apologies. · The roads were really crowded, so I couldn't make it on time

prompt: 日本語が上手になりたいなら、毎日少しずつでも話す____。
meaning: should; the best thing is to (advice)
note: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことだ · Personal advice from someone in a position to give it (teacher, parent, senior). Not used toward superiors. Compare 〜ものだ, which appeals to general norms. · If you want to get good at Japanese, you should speak it every day, even just a little.

prompt:
簡単な手術ですから、そんなに心配することはありませんよ。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: there's no need to; don't have to
note: Verb-dict + ことはない · Reassures or advises that something is unnecessary. Don't confuse with 〜たことはない ('have never done'). · It's a simple operation, so there's no need to worry so much.

prompt: 健康のために、週に三回はジムに通う____。
meaning: make it a rule to; make a point of
note: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことにしている · A personal rule the speaker (or subject) decided on and keeps. Compare 〜ことになっている, a rule or plan set by others. · For my health, I make it a rule to go to the gym at least three times a week.

prompt: この寮では、夜十一時までに戻る____。
meaning: it has been arranged that; it's the rule that; be supposed to
note: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ことになっている · Rules, customs or plans decided by others (a company, school, society), not a personal choice. Compare 〜ことにしている. · In this dorm, you're supposed to be back by 11 p.m.

prompt: レポートは、来週の金曜日までに提出する____。
meaning: must; do (written rule or instruction)
note: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + こと · Ends a sentence with こと to state a rule. Found in notices, regulations and teacher-to-student instructions. Impersonal; not used toward superiors. · Reports must be submitted by next Friday.

prompt: 医者に、お酒を飲みすぎないよ____に言われた。
meaning: tell someone to do; ask someone to do (reported command or request)
note: Verb-dict / Verb-nai + ように言う / ように頼む · Reports an instruction or request indirectly. Works with other verbs too: 伝える, 注意する, お願いする. Direct-quote version: 「〜てください」と言う. · My doctor told me not to drink too much.

prompt:
ドアを開けようとしたが、鍵がかかっていて開かなかった。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: try to; attempt to; be about to
note: Verb-volitional + とする · Often an attempt that fails or is interrupted. 〜ようとしない = 'won't even try' (unwillingness). Compare 〜てみる, which means actually doing something to see how it goes. · I tried to open the door, but it was locked and wouldn't open.

prompt: この雨は、夕方までやみ____。
meaning: unlikely to; doesn't look like it will
note: Verb-stem + そうにない / そうもない · Negative of the appearance 〜そうだ with verbs, based on what the speaker observes. More emphatic: 〜そうにもない. With adjectives use 〜なさそうだ instead. · This rain doesn't look like it will stop before evening.

prompt: この町の人口は、減る____。
meaning: keep on -ing; more and more (change in one direction)
note: Verb-dict + 一方だ · Steady change in one direction, usually (not always) for the worse. Used with verbs of change such as 増える, 減る, 上がる, 悪くなる. · This town's population just keeps on shrinking.

prompt: インターネットは便利な____、危険な面もある。
meaning: while; on the other hand; at the same time
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + である + 一方で · Presents two sides of one thing, or two parallel activities. Compare 〜に対して, which contrasts two different subjects. · The internet is convenient, but on the other hand it has its dangers.

prompt: お客様____、そんな言い方をしてはいけない。
meaning: toward; against; in contrast to
note: Noun + に対して / Noun + に対する + Noun / Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + のに対して · Marks the target of an action, attitude or feeling, or contrasts two things. Compare 〜について, which marks the topic being discussed rather than a target. · You mustn't speak like that to a customer.

prompt: 今日の授業では、日本の食文化____話し合いました。
meaning: about; concerning; regarding
note: Noun + について / Noun + についての + Noun · Marks the topic of speaking, thinking or research. More formal: 〜に関して. Compare 〜に対して (the target of an attitude or action). · In today's class, we discussed Japanese food culture.

prompt: この橋は、有名な建築家____設計された。
meaning: by (agent); by means of; due to; depending on
note: Noun + によって / Noun + による + Noun · Uses: agent of a passive (formal, for creating or discovering), cause, means, and 'varies by'. 〜によっては = 'in some cases, depending on'. · This bridge was designed by a famous architect.

prompt: 天気予報____、週末は大雪になるそうだ。
meaning: according to
note: Noun + によると / Noun + によれば · Names the source of information. The sentence usually ends in a hearsay expression such as 〜そうだ, 〜らしい or 〜ということだ. · According to the weather forecast, there's going to be heavy snow this weekend.

prompt: この映画は子ども____、大人も楽しめる。
meaning: not only ... but also
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + ばかりでなく · Same meaning as 〜だけでなく but a little more formal. The second part usually contains も or まで. · Not only children but adults too can enjoy this film.

prompt: この店は料理がおいしい____、値段も安い。
meaning: not only ... but also
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + だけでなく · Common in both speech and writing. Casual: 〜だけじゃなくて. Slightly less formal than 〜ばかりでなく. · This restaurant not only has delicious food, it's cheap too.

prompt: 彼女は歌____歌えば、ピアノも弾く。
meaning: both ... and ...; not only ... but also
note: Noun + も + Verb-ba + Noun + も / Noun + も + i-Adj stem + ければ + Noun + も · Lists two facts of the same kind for emphasis; contrasting pairs (いいときも悪いときも) are very common. Compare 〜し, which lists reasons. · She both sings and plays the piano.

prompt: 今日は春____暖かい一日だった。
meaning: typical of; befitting; truly like
note: Noun + らしい · Having the qualities you expect of the noun. Negative: 〜らしくない ('not like'). Differs from the hearsay 〜らしい (N4) and from 〜っぽい (looks like X but isn't). · Today was a warm, truly spring-like day.

prompt: この服はちょっと子ども____から、別のにしよう。
meaning: -ish; -like; tends to (casual)
note: Noun / Verb-stem / i-Adj stem + っぽい · Noun + っぽい: seems like X though it isn't (大人っぽい). Verb-stem + っぽい: tends to (怒りっぽい). Compare 〜らしい, which means truly typical of X. · This outfit is a bit childish, so let's go with a different one.

prompt: 日本の伝統____な料理を食べてみたい。
meaning: -ic; -al; in terms of
note: Noun + 的な + Noun / Noun + 的に · Turns a (usually kanji) noun into a na-adjective: 的な before nouns, 的に before verbs and adjectives. Many are best learned as words: 具体的, 基本的, 積極的. · I'd like to try traditional Japanese food.

prompt: 私も、あなたの____優しい看護師になりたいです。
meaning: like; as; such as
note: Verb-plain / Noun + の + ような / ように · ような comes before nouns, ように before verbs and adjectives. AのようなB can also mean 'B such as A'. Casual: 〜みたいな / 〜みたいに. · I want to become a kind nurse like you, too.

prompt: この部屋は広くて明るくて、まるでホテルの____。
meaning: just like; as if
note: まるで + Verb-plain / Noun + の + ようだ · まるで signals a figurative comparison: it only seems so. Casual: まるで〜みたいだ. Compare N2 〜かのようだ. · This room is so big and bright, it's just like a hotel.

prompt: 隣の家は何日も電気が消えている。家族で旅行に出かけた____。
meaning: must be; surely; no doubt
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に違いない · Strong conviction based on evidence or intuition; a slightly written tone. Compare 〜に決まっている, which is more subjective and conversational. · The lights next door have been off for days. The family must have gone on a trip.

prompt: 練習もしないで試合に出たら、負ける____。
meaning: certainly; is bound to; of course
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に決まっている · A very confident, subjective judgment, common in conversation (〜に決まってる). More assertive than 〜に違いない and not suited to formal writing. · If you play the match without practicing, you're bound to lose.

prompt: この人とは、どこかで会ったことがある____。
meaning: have a feeling that; feel like
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + 気がする / Verb-plain / Noun + の + ような + 気がする · A vague, intuitive impression rather than a firm judgment; ような気がする is even softer. Different from N4 〜がする (a smell, sound or taste). · I feel like I've met this person somewhere before.

prompt: けさは朝ご飯を食べ____家を出た。
meaning: without doing
note: Verb-nai stem + ずに · More formal, written-style equivalent of 〜ないで. Irregular: する → せずに (not しずに), 来る → 来ずに (こずに). · This morning I left home without eating breakfast.

prompt: エアコンをつけた____寝てしまい、風邪をひいた。
meaning: as it is; unchanged; while still (in a state)
note: Verb-ta / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + まま · An expected change hasn't happened and the state continues. Often suggests something unusual or undesirable (leaving the lights on, shoes on indoors). · I fell asleep with the air conditioner on and caught a cold.

prompt: 若い____、いろいろな国を旅行したほうがいい。
meaning: while (before it changes); before it's too late; in the course of
note: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + うちに · Do something while a condition lasts, before it changes; or a change that happens unnoticed during an activity. Compare 〜間に, which marks a fixed period without that urgency. · You should travel to lots of

pattern: 〜ところに / 〜ところへ / 〜ところを
prompt: 出かけようとしている____、友達から電話がかかってきた。
meaning: just when; at the moment (someone arrives or something interrupts)
note: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / Verb-ta + ところに / ところへ / ところを · ところに/へ: something happens or someone arrives at that moment, often interrupting. ところを: the scene is the object of a verb like 見る, 見つかる, 助ける. Set phrase: お忙しいところを. · Just as I was about to go out, a friend called.

prompt: 日本語は、勉強すればする____面白くなる。
meaning: the more ... the more
note: Verb-ba + Verb-dict + ほど / i-Adj stem + ければ + i-Adj + ほど / na-Adj + なら + na-Adj + な + ほど · The same word is repeated, first in the ば/なら form, then in plain form. The first part can be dropped: 考えるほど分からなくなる. · The more you study Japanese, the more interesting it gets.

prompt: 昨日は、立っていられない____疲れていた。
meaning: to the extent that; so ... that
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + ほど · Shows degree with an example or comparison. Often interchangeable with 〜くらい, but ほど sounds more formal and suits high degrees; it can't mark something as minimal. · Yesterday I was so tired I could hardly stand.

prompt: おなかが痛くて、歩けない____だった。
meaning: to the extent that; so ... that; at least (something minimal)
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + くらい · Like 〜ほど, shows degree. くらい can also mark something as small or easy ('at least; such a simple thing as'), a use ほど doesn't have. · My stomach hurt so much I could barely walk.

prompt: 忙しくて、昼ご飯を食べる時間____なかった。
meaning: even
note: Noun + さえ / Noun + でさえ / Noun + にさえ · Gives an extreme example, implying 'so naturally the others too'. More formal than 〜も or 〜でも in this sense. As a subject: 〜でさえ. Compare N1 〜すら. · I was so busy I didn't even have time to eat lunch.

prompt: このアプリさえあれ____、どこでも日本語の勉強ができる。
meaning: if only; as long as; provided that
note: Noun + さえ + Verb-ba / Verb-stem + さえ + すれば / Verb-te + さえ + いれば · Stresses that this one condition is enough by itself, or is the only thing missing. · As long as you have this app, you can study Japanese anywhere.

prompt: 「いつもありがとう。」「いえ、こちら____。」
meaning: precisely; it is ... that; (strong emphasis)
note: Noun + こそ · Singles out one thing as the very one that matters. こちらこそ is a set reply: 'the thanks/pleasure is mine'. Related N2 forms: 〜からこそ, 〜てこそ. · 'Thanks for everything.' 'No, thank you!'

prompt: 兄は、エンジニア____アメリカの会社で働いている。
meaning: as; in the role or capacity of
note: Noun + として / Noun + としての + Noun · States a role, status or category. Compare 〜にとって, which states from whose point of view a judgment is made. · My older brother works as an engineer at an American company.

prompt: 私____、家族は何よりも大切なものです。
meaning: for; to (from the standpoint of)
note: Noun + にとって / Noun + にとっての + Noun · Followed by an evaluation (大切だ, 難しい, 便利だ). Not for actions or attitudes toward someone; use 〜に対して for those. · To me, family is more important than anything.

prompt: 初めて作った____、このケーキはよくできている。
meaning: for (considering it's); unexpectedly for
note: Verb-plain / Noun + にしては · The result is different from what you'd expect of X. Doesn't follow adjectives; compare 〜わりに, which can and focuses on degree (price, age, effort). · For a first attempt, this cake turned out really well.

prompt: 忙しかった____、電話一本ぐらいできたでしょう。
meaning: even if; even considering; granted that
note: Verb-plain / Noun + にしても · Accepts a point, then says it doesn't change the speaker's view. Often accepts a fact; compare 〜としても, which is more purely hypothetical. · Even if you were busy, you could at least have made one phone call.

note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + というより · Corrects or refines a description: the second one fits better. Often followed by むしろ. · Today it's not so much cool as almost cold.

note: Verb-stem + かねない · Only for undesirable outcomes. Despite the ない, the meaning is positive: 'there's a real risk that ...'. Don't confuse with 〜かねる (cannot). · If you keep driving that recklessly, you could end up causing a serious accident.

prompt:
申し訳ございませんが、そのご質問にはお答えしかねます。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: cannot; be unable to (polite refusal); find it hard to
note: Verb-stem + かねる · A soft, formal way to decline, very common in customer service. It expresses reluctance or difficulty for the speaker, not physical inability. · I'm very sorry, but I'm unable to answer that question.

prompt: あまりにひど____ニュースに、怒りを感じずにはいられなかった。
meaning: can't help doing; can't resist doing
note: Verb-nai stem + ずにはいられない · する becomes せずにはいられない. 〜ないではいられない is a slightly more conversational equivalent. An inner urge, unlike 〜ざるを得ない (forced by circumstances). · I couldn't help feeling angry at such terrible news.

prompt: 予算が足りないので、計画を縮小せ____。
meaning: have no choice but to; cannot help but
note: Verb-nai stem + ざるを得ない · Circumstances force an action the speaker doesn't really want to take. する becomes せざるを得ない. More formal than 〜しかない. · The budget is insufficient, so we have no choice but to scale back the plan.

prompt: 締め切りが迫っているので、のんびりし____。
meaning: can't afford to (keep) doing; can't just
note: Verb-te + はいられない · The situation doesn't allow one to stay in state A, so one feels pushed to act. Casual: 〜ちゃいられない / 〜てらんない. · The deadline is approaching, so I can't afford to take it easy.

prompt: あんな失礼な店には、二度と行く____。
meaning: no way (will I); as if; I'll never
note: Verb-dict / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものか · Strong emotional denial or refusal; not a real question. Conversational form: 〜もんか; polite/feminine: 〜ものですか. · No way am I ever going to that rude shop again.

prompt: 免許は取った____、怖くてまだ一度も運転していない。
meaning: although; even though (but the expected result doesn't follow)
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ものの · Admits the first fact, then says things didn't go as it would suggest. More written than 〜けれども. · Although I got my license, I'm too scared and still haven't driven once.

prompt: できる____、学生時代に戻ってもう一度やり直したい。
meaning: if (it were possible); if only one could
note: Verb-dict (potential form) + ものなら · For something hard or impossible to do; the main clause is often 〜たい or a challenge. Don't confuse with N1 〜(よ)うものなら ('if one dared to ..., something bad would happen'). · If only I could, I'd go back to my student days and do it all over again

prompt: あんな人に頭を下げる____、会社を辞めたほうがましだ。
meaning: rather than; if it comes to (doing that), I'd rather
note: Verb-dict + くらいなら / Verb-dict + ぐらいなら · A is something the speaker strongly dislikes; B is the lesser evil or better choice, often with 〜ほうがいい / 〜ほうがましだ. · I'd rather quit my job than bow my head to someone like him.

prompt: この画家の初期の作品には、見る人の心を強く打つ____。
meaning: there is something (about it that is) ...; it really is
note: Verb-dict / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ものがある · Expresses the speaker's strong impression of a quality sensed in something. It's an evaluation, not a statement about literal existence. · There is something in this painter's early works that deeply moves the viewer.

prompt: この日が来るのを、どれほど待ち望んだ____。
meaning: how ...!; how much ...!
note: Question word + … + Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ことか · Usually paired with どんなに, どれほど, 何度, etc. Not a real question; it conveys deep feeling. Slightly written or dramatic in tone. · How long I've waited for this day to come!

prompt: 驚いた____、彼は会社を辞めてパン屋を開いたそうだ。
meaning: (emotion)-ly; what is (surprising, sad, etc.) is that
note: Verb-ta / i-Adj / na-Adj + な + ことに（は） · An emotion word (驚いた, 残念な, うれしい, 不思議な) states the speaker's feeling before giving the fact. Fairly written. · Surprisingly, I heard he quit his company and opened a bakery.

prompt: 几帳面な彼の____、書類はもう準備してあるだろう。
meaning: knowing (someone); since it's (someone), surely
note: Noun + の + ことだから · From what the speaker knows of a person's character, it leads to a guess about their behavior. Usually followed by だろう, きっと or に違いない. · Knowing how meticulous he is, he's probably got the documents ready already.

prompt: 彼は三十年間、一日も休む____店を開け続けた。
meaning: without (doing); without ever
note: Verb-dict + ことなく · A written equivalent of 〜ないで / 〜ずに, often implying that something one might expect to happen did not. · For thirty years, he kept his shop open without taking a single day off.

prompt: この坂は、昔から桜の名所である____「桜坂」と呼ばれている。
meaning: from the fact that; because; judging from
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ことから · Gives the evidence or origin behind a name, judgment or conclusion. Common in explanations of place names and in reports. · This slope is called 'Sakura-zaka' because it has long been a famous spot for cherry bl

prompt: 実際に会って話してみ____、どんな人か分からない。
meaning: unless; if ... not (then it can't happen)
note: Verb-nai / i-Adj-ku + ない / na-Adj + でない / Noun + でない + ことには · The main clause is negative (分からない, できない, 始まらない): without A, B can't happen. More emphatic than 〜なければ. · You can't tell what someone is like unless you actually meet and talk to them.

prompt:
あの映画、見たことは見たけど、途中で寝てしまった。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: it's true that ..., but; (I) do ..., but
note: Verb-plain + ことは + Verb-plain + が / i-Adj + ことは + i-Adj + が / na-Adj + な + ことは + na-Adj + だ + が · The same word is repeated to admit something only partly before adding a reservation. けど replaces が in speech. · I did watch that movie, but I fell asleep halfway through.

prompt: さんざん迷った____、結局どちらも買わなかった。
meaning: after (a long, troublesome process); in the end
note: Verb-ta + あげく / Noun + の + あげく · The result is usually negative or disappointing. 〜末(に) is neutral and can end well; あげく stresses frustration. あげくの果てに is an intensified form. · After agonizing over it for ages, in the end I didn't buy either.

prompt: 彼女は緊張の____、スピーチの内容を忘れてしまった。
meaning: so much that; out of excessive; because of too much
note: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / na-Adj + な / Noun + の + あまり（に） · An extreme degree of a feeling or state leads to an unusual, often unwanted result. Mostly with emotion nouns (緊張, 心配, 驚き, 悲しみ). · She was so nervous that she forgot what she was going to say in her speech.

prompt: あのレストランは料理がおいしい____に、値段も手頃だ。
meaning: besides; on top of; in addition to
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + である + 上（に） · Adds a second point of the same kind (good + good, bad + bad). に may be dropped in writing. It isn't normally followed by a command or request. · That restaurant has delicious food, and on top of that, the prices are reasonabl

prompt: 家族とよく相談した____、お返事いたします。
meaning: after (doing), upon; in (doing), when it comes to
note: Verb-ta + 上で / Noun + の + 上で / Verb-dict + 上で · Verb-ta + 上で: do A first, then B on that basis. Verb-dict + 上で: 'in the process of / for the purpose of A'. Business writing often shortens it to ご確認の上. · I'll give you my answer after discussing it carefully with my family.

prompt: 引き受けた____は、最後まで責任を持ってやり遂げるつもりだ。
meaning: since; now that; as long as
note: Verb-plain / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + 以上（は） · From a given situation, draws an obligation, resolve or firm judgment. Near-synonym of 〜からには; 以上は sounds more formal and logical, からには more like personal resolve. · Now that I've taken it on, I intend to see it through responsibly

prompt: オリンピックに出る____、メダルを狙いたい。
meaning: now that; since (having done/being ..., one must)
note: Verb-plain / Noun + である + からには · Expresses resolve: having reached this situation, one should see it through. Often ends with 〜たい, 〜つもりだ, 〜なければならない. Compare 〜以上(は), which is more formal and neutral. · Since I'm competing in the Olympics, I want to go for a medal.

prompt: 君のことを思っている____、厳しいことを言うんだ。
meaning: precisely because; it is because ... that
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + だ / Noun + だ + からこそ · Stresses that this reason, and no other, is the real one, often a reason the listener wouldn't expect. Frequently ends with 〜のだ. · It's precisely because I care about you that I'm being hard on you.

prompt: 空の様子____、午後は雨になりそうだ。
meaning: judging from; (starting) even with; to begin with
note: Noun + からして · Two uses: 'judging from X' (basis for a guess), and 'even X, let alone the rest', where one example stands for the whole, often critically. · Judging from the look of the sky, it's likely to rain in the afternoon.

prompt: あの話し方____、彼は関西の出身だろう。
meaning: judging from; from the standpoint of
note: Noun + からすると / Noun + からすれば · Gives either the evidence for a judgment or the viewpoint of a person. Close to 〜から見ると; unlike 〜からいうと, it can take a person. · Judging from the way he talks, he's probably from the Kansai area.

prompt: 外国人____、日本の習慣には不思議なものが多いらしい。
meaning: from the point of view of; judging from; seen from
note: Noun + から見ると / Noun + から見れば · Looks at something from a person's position or from given evidence. 〜から見て and 〜から見ても are also common. · Apparently, from a foreigner's point of view, many Japanese customs seem strange.

prompt: 立地____、駅前のマンションのほうが便利だ。
meaning: in terms of; from the standpoint of; judging by
note: Noun + からいうと / Noun + からいって · The noun is a criterion or viewpoint (立場, 経験, 値段), not a person: say 親からすると, not ×親からいうと. 〜からいえば is also used. · In terms of location, the apartment in front of the station is more convenient.

prompt: お降りの____は、お忘れ物のないようご注意ください。
meaning: when; at the time of; on the occasion of
note: Verb-dict / Verb-ta / Noun + の + 際（に） · A formal version of 〜とき, common in announcements and instructions. Unlike 〜に際して, it's fine for everyday occasions. · When getting off, please make sure you don't leave anything behind.

prompt: 詳しい日程が決まり____、皆様にご連絡いたします。
meaning: as soon as (then immediately)
note: Verb-stem + 次第 / Noun + 次第 · Formal, for a planned future action that follows right after A (contacting, starting). Not used when the main clause is in the past. Compare 〜次第で (depending on). · We will contact everyone as soon as the detailed schedule is decided.

prompt: 合格できるかどうかは、これからの努力____。
meaning: depending on; it depends on
note: Noun + 次第だ / Noun + 次第で / Noun + 次第では · The outcome is decided by A. 〜次第では points to one possible outcome among several. · Whether you pass depends on your efforts from now on.

prompt: 半年にわたる交渉の____、両社はようやく合意に達した。
meaning: after (a long process of); finally, at the end of
note: Verb-ta + 末（に） / Noun + の + 末（に） · Neutral: the outcome may be good or bad and is often a decision or conclusion. Use 〜あげく when the result is negative or frustrating. · After six months of negotiations, the two companies finally reached an agreement.

prompt: 今から急いだ____、終電には間に合わないだろう。
meaning: even if (it would be no use); no matter how much
note: Verb-ta + ところで · The main clause says the effort is useless or the result wouldn't matter much. Often with いくら, どんなに, 今さら. Different from 〜たところ (when I did, I found). · Even if we hurry now, we probably won't make the last train.

prompt: 駅の窓口で問い合わせ____、その電車は運休しているとのことだった。
meaning: when (I) did ..., (I found that); upon doing
note: Verb-ta + ところ · Reports what turned out after an action, often a discovery. The result is a past fact beyond the speaker's control. More formal than 〜たら. · When I asked at the station window, I was told that the train wasn't running.

prompt: 彼は約束の時間に遅れた____、謝りもしなかった。
meaning: not only ... but also
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / Noun + ばかりか · Stronger than 〜だけでなく; the second item is often more surprising and marked by も, まで or さえ. Unlike 〜だけでなく, it isn't followed by commands or requests. · Not only was he late, he didn't even apologize.

prompt: 確認を一つ怠った____、大きな損害を出してしまった。
meaning: simply because; just because (with a bad result)
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + ばかりに · The main clause is an unwanted result, often with regret. The set form 〜たいばかりに ('just because one wanted to') explains a strong motive. · Simply because I skipped one check, I ended up causing heavy losses.

prompt: 駅前の商店街は、客が減る____。
meaning: keep (getting worse); only continue to
note: Verb-dict + ばかりだ · Change continuing in one direction, almost always for the worse. 〜一方だ (N3) is similar but can also describe neutral or good trends. · The shopping street in front of the station just keeps losing customers.

prompt: この公園は、週末____平日も家族連れでにぎわう。
meaning: not to mention; of course ... and also
note: Noun + はもちろん / Noun + はもとより · A is the obvious case; B is added with も or まで. 〜はもとより is more formal and written than 〜はもちろん. · This park is busy with families on weekdays, not to mention weekends.

prompt: 見た目____、味はなかなかいい。
meaning: setting aside; regardless of; whatever about
note: Noun + はともかく / Noun + はともかくとして · Sets A aside to focus on B, which the speaker sees as more important. Compare 〜はさておき, used more to shelve a topic for now and move on. · Looks aside, it tastes pretty good.

prompt: 冗談____、そろそろ本題に入りましょう。
meaning: leaving aside; putting aside (for now)
note: Noun + はさておき · Often used to switch to the main point, as in 冗談はさておき or それはさておき. Slightly more formal than 〜はともかく. · Joking aside, let's get down to business.

prompt: 都会の暮らしは便利な____、ストレスも多い。
meaning: on the other hand; while (it is ...)
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj + な / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + 反面 · Presents two opposite sides of the same thing. 〜一方で (N3) is broader and can also contrast two different things. · City life is convenient, but on the other hand it's also stressful.

prompt: 狭い____も、日当たりのいい快適な部屋だ。
meaning: although; despite; while (contrary to expectation)
note: Verb-stem / Verb-nai / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + ながら（も） · Not the 'while doing' ながら: the subject is in state A, yet B is true. Set phrases: 残念ながら, 知りながら, 及ばずながら. · Although it's small, it's a comfortable, sunny room.

prompt:
今年の業績を振り返りつつ、来年の目標を考えたい。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: while (doing); although, even while
note: Verb-stem + つつ / Verb-stem + つつも · つつ alone is a written 〜ながら (two actions at once). つつも means 'although', typically with verbs of knowing or thinking (思いつつ, 知りつつ). · While looking back on this year's results, I'd like to think about next year's goals.

prompt: 地球の平均気温は、年々上昇し____。
meaning: be in the process of; be gradually (changing)
note: Verb-stem + つつある · Written style for change that is underway toward some result. Used with change verbs (増える, 回復する, 変わる), not with simple ongoing actions like 食べる. · The earth's average temperature is steadily rising year by year.

prompt: 部屋の電気をつけ____にして出かけてしまった。
meaning: leaving (something) as is; keep (doing) without a break
note: Verb-stem + っぱなし · Either something left undone that should have been dealt with (often a complaint), or a state that goes on without a break. Conversational. · I went out and left the light on in my room.

prompt:
足を痛めていたが、彼は最後まで走り抜いた。
→ điền dạng: ____
meaning: do to the very end; see through; do thoroughly
note: Verb-stem + 抜く · Stresses finishing something hard despite difficulty, or doing it to the fullest (考え抜く, 生き抜く). · Although he had hurt his leg, he ran all the way to the finish.

prompt: どんなに注意して____ても、事故は起こり得る。
meaning: can; be possible / cannot; be impossible
note: Verb-stem + 得る / Verb-stem + 得ない · Logical possibility, not personal skill (not ×泳ぎ得る for 'can swim'). The positive is read うる or える; other forms use え- (えない, えた). · No matter how careful you are, accidents can happen.

prompt: あの誠実な人が不正をしたとは、信じ____。
meaning: hard to; almost impossible to (emotionally)
note: Verb-stem + がたい · Used with verbs of thinking and feeling (信じる, 理解する, 許す, 離れる). Unlike 〜にくい, not for physical difficulty (×この肉は食べがたい). · It's hard to believe that such an honest person committed fraud.

prompt: 連絡先が分からないので、知らせ____。
meaning: there's no way to; cannot possibly (no means available)
note: Verb-stem + ようがない / Noun + の + しようがない · There's no method at all, even if one wanted to. 〜ようもない is more emphatic. With suru-nouns: 説明のしようがない. · I don't have his contact details, so there's no way to let him know.

prompt: こんな簡単なミスをする____、大きな仕事は任せられない。
meaning: if (you are like this / keep doing this), (it's no good)
note: Verb-plain + ようでは · Criticizes an undesirable state and predicts a bad outcome; the main clause is negative (〜ない, 困る, だめだ). · If you make simple mistakes like this, we can't trust you with big jobs.

prompt: 故郷の母のことが心配で____。
meaning: can't help (feeling); feel terribly; extremely
note: Verb-te + ならない / i-Adj-ku + てならない / na-Adj + でならない · For feelings or impressions that arise on their own (気がする, 思われる, 心配だ, 残念だ). More formal and written than 〜てたまらない / 〜てしょうがない. · I can't stop worrying about my mother back home.

prompt: 自分で経験し____、本当の意味で理解できるのだ。
meaning: only by (doing); only when
note: Verb-te + こそ · Stresses that A is the essential condition for the real value or result in B. 〜てはじめて (N3) is more neutral, focusing on timing. · Only by experiencing it yourself can you truly understand it.

prompt: 実物を見____、買うかどうか決められない。
meaning: not until (after doing); only after
note: Verb-te + からでないと / Verb-te + からでなければ · The main clause is negative or expresses difficulty: B can't happen unless A is done first. · I can't decide whether to buy it until I've seen the real thing.

prompt: 大学を卒業し____、彼とは一度も会っていない。
meaning: ever since
note: Verb-te + 以来 / Noun + 以来 · The main clause is a state or habit continuing from that past point up to now, not a single later event. More formal than 〜てから. · I haven't seen him once since we graduated from university.

prompt: それは単なるうわさ____。
meaning: merely; nothing more than; only
note: Verb-plain / Noun + に過ぎない · Downplays something as small or unimportant. Often with ただ or 単なる. · That's nothing more than a rumor.

prompt: 疲れたときは、早く寝る____。
meaning: nothing beats; the best thing is
note: Verb-dict / Verb-nai / Noun + に限る · The speaker's personal conviction that something is the best choice; conversational. For a more general 'it's best to', use 〜に越したことはない. · When you're tired, there's nothing better than going to bed early.

prompt: この遊園地は、子ども____大人にも人気がある。
meaning: not only; not limited to
note: Noun + に限らず · Widens the scope beyond A; the second part usually has も. Close to 〜だけでなく but a bit more formal. · This amusement park is popular not only with children but with adults as well.

prompt: 傘を持っていない日____、雨が降るんだよね。
meaning: of all (times/people); precisely when; (someone) of all people wouldn't
note: Noun + に限って · Two uses: (1) 'just when', complaining that bad luck strikes at the worst time; (2) with はずがない / ない, firm trust that a particular person wouldn't do something. · It always rains on exactly the days I don't have an umbrella.

prompt: 本日ご来店のお客様____、全商品を二割引きいたします。
meaning: limited to; only (for)
note: Noun + に限り · Formal; typical of notices, ads and rules to state who or what a condition applies to. · For customers visiting today only, all items are 20% off.

prompt: 私の知る____、彼が約束を破ったことは一度もない。
meaning: as long as; as far as (to the limit of)
note: Verb-dict / Verb-te + いる / i-Adj / na-Adj + である / Noun + である + かぎり · 'As long as' a condition holds, or 'as far as' the limit of knowledge or ability (私の知るかぎり, できるかぎり). Also written 限り. Different from 〜に限り (limited to). · As far as I know, he has never once broken a promise.

prompt: よほどのことが____、明日の会議には出席します。
meaning: unless; as long as ... not
note: Verb-nai + かぎり · B holds as long as A doesn't happen. More emphatic and formal than 〜なければ. · Unless something serious comes up, I'll attend tomorrow's meeting.

prompt: 料理の腕____、うちの父は誰にも負けない。
meaning: when it comes to; in terms of (skill)
note: Noun + にかけては / Noun + にかけても · Praises someone's ability in a specific field; typically followed by 誰にも負けない, 一番だ, 自信がある. · When it comes to cooking, my father is second to none.

prompt: ファンの声援____、選手たちは手を振った。
meaning: in response to; meeting (expectations, requests)
note: Noun + にこたえて / Noun + にこたえる + Noun · Used with nouns like 期待, 要望, 声援, 要求. Also written 〜に応えて. Compare 〜に応じて, which means adjusting to a condition. · The players waved in response to the fans' cheers.

prompt: 新作映画の公開____、完成披露試写会が開かれた。
meaning: prior to; before
note: Noun + に先立って / Verb-dict + に先立って / Noun + に先立つ + Noun · Formal; for preparations or events that come before an important occasion. 〜に先立ち is the written form. · Prior to the release of the new film, a premiere screening was held.

prompt: たとえ冗談____、そんなことを言うべきではない。
meaning: even if; whether ... or ...; in any case
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + にしろ・にせよ · Same meaning as 〜にしても (N3) but more formal; にせよ is the most written. The paired form AにしろBにしろ means 'whether A or B'. · Even if it was a joke, you shouldn't say something like that.

prompt: 子ども____、親の小言はうるさいだけなのだろう。
meaning: from the standpoint of; for (someone), (it would seem)
note: Noun + にすれば / Noun + にしたら · Imagines how things feel from another person's position (usually not the speaker's). Unlike 〜にとって, it focuses on that person's feelings or opinion. · From a child's point of view, parents' nagging is probably just annoying.

prompt: この筆跡は、父のもの____。
meaning: without doubt; must be; surely
note: Verb-plain / i-Adj / na-Adj / Noun + に相違ない · A written, formal equivalent of 〜に違いない (N3). Also seen on forms: 上記の通り相違ありません ('the above is correct'). · This handwriting is without doubt my father's.
